# Description of Changes

## Risk level: Low

This is a low risk change because it consists only of aesthetic changes to music. It must pass the CI checks in order for changes to be merged and deployed, and any songs committed must be original and a banger.

## Type of Change

The type of changes made can be found on the labels associated with the pull request. The exact changes made can be found under the commits tab. (but will most likely not be useful because Git LFS can't show diffs)
